title: Biricha WDS Configuration for Synchronous Buck Converter
content:
Hello, 

I’m writing in regards to a project that I am doing that involves a STM32G474RGT being used to control a synchronous buck converter. In this set up I plan to use Peak Current Mode Control, which I found was supported by Biricha’s WDS software. As a result I configured my HRTimers and ADC and Comparators like the guides that I found online, mainly the step by step setup on the Biricha Youtube Channel. However, upon opening up the software, I noticed that the circuit tab for the buck setup would only show up as an asynchronous buck, using a diode instead of 2 N-Channel mosfets. Is there anyway to configure the software to use a synchronous buck topology? 

Brian
